1  BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHIVJYOTI SAIKIA  ORDER Date : 05.06.2025 Heard Ms. M. Hazarika, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Mr. D. Khan, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Also heard Mr. K. K. Das, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State of Assam and Mr. K. K. Parasar, learned CGC for the FSSAI.
Issue notice.
No formal notice is required to be sent to the respondents as because Mr. Das has accepted notice on behalf of respondent No.1 and Mr. Parasar has accepted notice on behalf of respondent No.2.
Extra copy of the petition shall be provided to both of them.
List this matter after 4(four) weeks.
Till returnable date, the further proceedings of C.R. Case No.81/2023, pending in the Court of the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Kamrup (Rural), Amingaon shall remain stayed.
